content.text:
I can’t run continuous background monitoring or push you a live ping when the PDF posts. I can, however, do one of these (pick what you prefer):

- If you upload the PDF or paste a URL here after it drops, I’ll immediately inspect the document and give a concise rundown of the Risk Factors section (I’ll inspect the relevant pages first, per your request).
- I can give you a small ready-to-run script you can run on your machine/server to watch the URL and notify you (Slack/webhook or email) the moment the PDF changes, and it will also save the file so you can then paste it here for summarization.

Below is a compact Python watcher you can run (or run as a cron job) — it checks the file URL, detects changes by checksum, downloads the new PDF, and posts a message to a Slack webhook. Replace URL and webhook values and run continuously or via scheduler.

Python watcher (Slack notification)
- Requirements: pip install requests python-slugify (only requests required)
- Configure: set FILE_URL and SLACK_WEBHOOK

```
import time, hashlib, requests

FILE_URL = "https://example.com/quarterly.pdf"
SLACK_WEBHOOK = "https://hooks.slack.com/services/XXX/YYY/ZZZ"
CHECK_INTERVAL = 60  # seconds
last_hash = None

def get_checksum(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

while True:
    try:
        r = requests.get(FILE_URL, timeout=20)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            h = get_checksum(r.content)
            if h != last_hash:
                last_hash = h
                # save file
                with open("latest_quarterly.pdf", "wb") as f:
                    f.write(r.content)
                # notify Slack
                payload = {"text": f"New quarterly PDF detected and saved as latest_quarterly.pdf\nSource: {FILE_URL}"}
                requests.post(SLACK_WEBHOOK, json=payload, timeout=10)
                print("New file detected and notified.")
        else:
            print("HTTP", r.status_code)
    except Exception as e:
        print("Error:", e)
    time.sleep(CHECK_INTERVAL)
```

If you prefer email instead of Slack I can provide a short smtplib snippet.

Next step: tell me which option you want. If you want me to summarize, either (A) upload the PDF here when it appears, or (B) give the exact URL where it will be posted and I’ll perform an on-demand check when you ask (I still can’t monitor continuously from here). Once I have the file or URL, I’ll inspect the Risk Factors section and provide a concise rundown.
